title: DCP Banded-QFT Truncation Phase-Leakage vs. Exact Dyadic Sublattice Fidelity Bridge
claims: Under band-b truncated QFT_{2^m}^{(b)_dagger}, the exact peak survival probability on |psi(K_0)> is prod_{j=0}^{m-1-b} cos^2(pi * sum_{l=j+b}^{m-1} k_l 2^{j-1-l}).
P_{QFT^{(b)}}(K_0 | K_0) == 1.0 holds iff K_0 == 0 (mod 2^{m-b}); in particular b = 1 (H^{tensor m}) is lossless iff K_0 in {0, 2^{m-1}}.
